thieu.huong: We need to know which way the house faces (measure with a compass or pick it on the satellite view).
thieu.sinh: We need your birth year and gender (taken from your profile).
thieu.nguoi_2: We need the birth year and gender of the person you live with.
thieu.dau_hieu: Answer the yes / no questions below to see whether your home has anything to deal with first.

luu_y: Feng shui here is a cultural lens for arranging a home sensibly — it does not replace an architect, promises no wealth and recommends no objects to buy.

cua_chinh.tieu_de: Does my main door direction suit me?
cua_chinh.mo_ta: Compares the door direction with your birth year, with things to do.
cua_chinh.cau_chat: Does my main door's current direction suit my birth year?
cua_chinh.chung: Whether a door direction suits you depends on your birth year: everyone has four supportive directions and four weaker ones. Measure the door and we compare it with yours.
viec: Keep the entrance bright and clear — no tall cabinets or shoes blocking the door.
An existing door does not need changing: the bed-head and desk directions make up for most of it.
vi_sao: Eight Mansions splits the eight directions into four supportive and four weaker ones by each person's Kua number; the main door is checked first.
cua_chinh.nguon: Yang Zhai Shi Shu (Great Wandering Year verse) · Ba Zhai Ming Jing.

bo_cuc.tieu_de: Is there anything in my home to deal with first?
bo_cuc.mo_ta: Four major form-and-layout points — checked before directions.
bo_cuc.cau_chat: Is there any layout issue in my home I should deal with first?
bo_cuc.chung: Form is the foundation: if any of the four major points below is present, deal with it first, then look at directions and timing.
viec: Answer four yes / no questions; for each 'yes' you get one no-cost thing to do right away.
vi_sao: This page follows 'form is the foundation, formula is the rhythm': a confirmed major sign keeps the related part at 'Balanced' until it is handled.
bo_cuc.nguon: Zang Shu · Yang Zhai Shi Shu · Vietnamese folk practice.

lien_ket.nhan: Let the system read room photos
Stand in the middle, point your phone

gia_dinh.tieu_de: We have different Kua groups — how do we arrange the home?
gia_dinh.mo_ta: Find directions that suit both, or how to split when there is none.
gia_dinh.cau_chat: My partner and I have different Kua groups — how should we arrange the home?
gia_dinh.chung: Two people in different groups is very common. Look for a shared direction first; if there is none, split: door and stove follow one person, bed-head and desk follow the other.
viec: Enter the birth year and gender of the person you live with to see your shared directions.
vi_sao: Each person has a Kua; two Kua in the same group (East or West) share all four supportive directions.
gia_dinh.nguon: Yang Zhai Shi Shu (couples of different groups).

han_nam.tieu_de: Which side of the home should stay undisturbed this year?
han_nam.mo_ta: Sides to avoid drilling or renovating this year; how your age sits for building work.
han_nam.cau_chat: Which side of my home should I avoid renovating this year?
viec: Drilling needed on a quiet side: move it to next year if you can; if not, keep it short — a few days, not weeks.
Small jobs that do not touch walls or floors (painting, lights, moving furniture) need no avoidance.
vi_sao: The annual stars move every year at Li Chun; the sides holding stars 5 and 2, and the Three Killings side, are traditionally left undisturbed.
han_nam.nguon: Xie Ji Bian Fang Shu (annual stars, Three Killings).

so_sanh.tieu_de: Choosing between two homes — how do I compare?
so_sanh.mo_ta: Save each home and view them side by side: levels and floor diagram, no score.
so_sanh.cau_chat: I am choosing between two homes — what should I compare?
so_sanh.chung: Compare in this order: which home has fewer major points to fix → whose door direction suits the owner better → where bedroom and stove fall. There is no total score; you see each part side by side.
viec: Measure and survey the first home, name it, then tap 'View another home' to add the second.
Open 'Compare two homes' once both are saved.
vi_sao: Major form issues are harder to fix than directions, so they are compared first.
so_sanh.nguon: The page's 'form first, formula second' principle.

lien_ket.nhan: Your home journey (add a home, compare two)

mo_quan.tieu_de: Opening a shop — what should I look at?
mo_quan.mo_ta: There is a dedicated tool for business premises and opening dates.
mo_quan.cau_chat: I am about to open a shop — how should I look at the premises and the opening date?
mo_quan.chung: For business premises three things matter: where the door and the till go, where the owner sits, and the opening date. A dedicated tool handles this using the premises' facing and the owner's birth year.
viec: Open 'Premises & Opening' to measure the facing and see where the three areas should go.
Pick an opening date by birth year in the day-selection tool.
vi_sao: Same Eight Mansions and flying-star maths as a home, but focused on door, till and the owner's seat.
mo_quan.nguon: Yang Zhai San Yao (door – master – stove), applied to premises.

mau.cua.chua_tuoi: The house faces {huong} ({do}°) — {nhom}. Add your birth year to see how well this suits you.
mau.cua.chua_do: The house faces {huong} — {nhom}. Measure the exact degree for a closer check (near a boundary the result can change).
mau.cua.hop: The door faces {huong}, one of your four supportive directions — {y}
mau.cua.khong_hop: The door faces {huong}, which is not one of your four supportive directions. An existing door does not need changing: make up for it with the bed-head and desk directions.
mau.cua.khac_nhom: House: {nhom_nha}. You: {nhom_menh}. Different groups — choose a bedroom and desk on a side that suits you.
mau.cua.viec_bu: Point the bed-head or desk towards one of: {ds}.
mau.cua.tran: The home has points to deal with first ({ds}), so this part stays at 'Balanced' at most until they are handled.
mau.cua.sao: Built / moved in {nam_xay}: Period {van}; the door side holds the star pair {son}–{sao_huong}.
mau.cua.sao_y: About the star pair at the door: {y}
mau.bc.co_lon: There are {n} point(s) to deal with first: {ds}.
mau.bc.khong_lon: None of the four major points is present — the foundation is sound. Now directions and timing matter.
mau.bc.con_nho: There are also {n} smaller point(s) to keep an eye on: {ds}.
mau.bc.chua_du: {n} of {tong} questions answered — answer the rest to be sure of the foundation.
mau.gd.thieu: Your supportive directions: {ds}. Add the person you live with to find shared ones.
mau.gd.viec.cung_nhom: Same group: choose door, bed-head and desk from the four shared directions.
mau.gd.viec.co_chung: Prioritise the shared direction(s) ({ds}) for the bed-head.
mau.gd.viec.khong_chung: No shared direction: door and stove follow the home's owner; bed-head follows whoever sleeps worse; each desk follows its own person.
mau.hn.tra_loi: In {nam} ({can_chi}), keep the {p5} and {p2} sides of the home undisturbed: avoid drilling, digging or major repairs there.
mau.hn.tra_loi_trung: In {nam} ({can_chi}), keep the centre of the home and the {p2} side undisturbed: avoid drilling or major repairs there.
mau.hn.tam_sat: The {p} side should also be left alone this year (Three Killings).
mau.hn.thai_tue: The {p} side (Tai Sui) and the opposite {pha} side (Sui Po): tradition avoids starting work facing these two.
mau.hn.moc: The year runs from Li Chun (around 4 February), not from 1 January.
mau.hn.phong: In your home, the {p} side holds the {phong}.
mau.hn.tuoi: Your age for building work in {nam_am}: {y}
